Many car screens hide new apps from their home screen. A small round Car Browser button can float on top of the car\'s screens so you can always open it (and, from its grid button, every hidden app).\n\nTap it to open Car Browser, drag it to move it. You can turn it off later in the menu.
Floating button is on. It shows up when you leave Car Browser; drag it anywhere.
Allow Car Browser to \"display over other apps\", then come back
No app on this device can open that link
Can\'t reach the internet. Check Wi-Fi or your phone hotspot.
Clear history, cookies, cache and saved site data? You will be signed out of websites.

The security certificate of %1$s could not be verified.

On older car screens this can happen even on safe sites, because the screen's list of trusted certificates is out of date.

Only continue if you trust this site, and don't type passwords or card numbers.
This screen\'s clock says %1$s.\n\nSecure websites (Google, YouTube…) will refuse to load until the date and time are correct.
Allow %1$s to use this device\'s location?
This kind of download isn\'t supported
Couldn\'t open the installer. Open Downloads and tap the file.
All apps on this screen (including hidden ones)
Tap to open. Long-press for app info.
These apps are installed but switched off. Tap one, then press \"Enable\".

Version %1$s

• Type in the top bar to search or open a website.
• Menu → Desktop site shows the full computer version of a site (nice on wide screens).
• Menu → Text size makes pages easier to read.
• If the car hides Car Browser after a restart, open it from Setting → Add account → Car Browser. That also brings the floating button back.
• Menu → Car Home screen makes a light home screen that starts with the car.
• Menu → Clean up apps helps switch off apps you never use.
• Menu → Update Car Browser gets the newest version in one tap.
• Menu → Floating button puts a Car Browser button over the car's own screens.
• The grid button opens every app on this screen, including ones the car hides, plus shortcuts into Android settings.
• If a heavy site (like YouTube) doesn't work here, tap "Get Firefox" on the home page. It installs a separate browser with a newer engine.

Only use the browser while parked.

Car Home becomes the screen your car shows when it starts and whenever you press Home. It's light: a clock, a search box and only the apps you pin. The car's top bar and climate controls stay as they are.

After you tap Turn on, Android asks which home screen to use. Choose Car Home, then:
• Just once, to try it
• Always, to keep it

The car's own home screen stays one tap away (the "Car's own home screen" tile). To switch back completely, come here and turn Car Home off.
Car Home is off. Press Home to go back to the car\'s own home screen.
Long-press any app in All apps to add it here. To stop using Car Home: open Car Browser → Menu → Car Home screen.

Switching off apps you never use stops them running in the background and frees memory. Tap an app; Android\'s page for it opens; press Disable. Nothing is deleted, and you can turn any of them back on here.
Only switch these off if you know what they are.
Tap one, then press Enable, to turn it back on.
%1$d apps the car needs (radio, climate, camera, Bluetooth, keyboard, home screen and Android itself) are hidden from this list so they can\'t be switched off by mistake.
Press \"Disable\". If there\'s no Disable button, \"Force stop\" closes it for now.
Press \"Enable\" to turn it back on

Car Browser doesn\'t recognise this app. Only switch it off if you know what it does.\n\nIf something in the car stops working afterwards, come back to Clean up apps. It will be listed under \"Switched off\", and you can turn it back on.
Move Car Browser to the car\'s storage
Car Browser is stored on the SD card, so it disappears after every restart and Car Home can\'t start with the car.\n\nTap Open, then press \"Move to tablet\" (or \"Move to device storage\").
These apps will vanish when the car restarts. Tap each one, then \"Move to tablet\":
Press \"Move to tablet\" (or \"Move to device storage\")
The downloaded file isn\'t Car Browser.
